#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class FS {
    istream& in;
    stringstream ss;
public:
    FS(istream& str) : in(str) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (token.empty()) {
            if (ss >> token) return token;
            string line;
            if (!getline(in, line)) return "";
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(line);
        }
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

long long solve(int n, int m) {
    if (n > 2) {
        return (long long)n * m / 2 * 2;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return m / 6 * 6 + 2 * max(m % 6 - 3, 0);
    }
    switch (m) {
        case 2:
            return 0;
        case 3:
            return 4;
        case 7:
            return 12;
        default:
            return 2 * m;
    }
}

int main() {
    FS in(cin);
    
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }
    
    cout << solve(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
